method: Manual review of original owned-display PNG captures; numerical checks alone do not establish visual acceptance.

Useful outside view of the car and both riders at this pose.
reviewed.combined/accept-THIRD_PERSON_FRONT-dev.p: Useful outside front view at this pose. Does not cancel the obstruction observed in other views.
reviewed.combined/accept-second-unloaded-dev.png: Normal first-person view beside the stopped car after final unloading.
reviewed.combined/accept-second-unloaded-observer: Normal first-person view from the station platform after final unloading.

result: External-view visual acceptance remains open; obstruction is pose/view dependent. No root cause or universal camera support claimed.
